description: Compact idle threads minutes before their prompt cache expires, so compaction runs on a warm cache instead of paying cold re-input rates. Reads exact cache lifetimes from Claude Code and Pi for native compaction, and compacts Antigravity CLI threads via /compact using a configurable fallback TTL. Skips threads whose cache has already expired, threads under your token threshold, and threads with queued work or active child threads. Includes a live countdown dashboard in Settings and bb cache-compact CLI commands; requires BB 0.50 or later with no external service or separate account.
